answer_1.quote: In the open-ended task, models generate free-form answers.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate 'True' or 'False' responses to statements and answers to open-ended questions.

answer_2.quote: In the multiple-choice task, models select an answer from multiple correct and incorrect options by comparing the conditional probabilities of candidate options given the question.

answer_3.quote: Following Chuang et al. (2023), we use 6-shot prompting (see Appendix B) and employ OpenAI's GPT-4o (Achiam et al., 2023) to evaluate three aspects of the responses: truthfulness (True %), informativeness (Info %), and overall (True × Info %).
methods: binary classification of truthfulness and informativeness
